mintAuthority.summary: gPYUSDse mints shares only against deposited native Stable PYUSD and configured accrual fee shares (currently 0%). Immutable Sourcify-verified VaultV2 and owner, curator, and allocator parameter roles cannot mint native PYUSD, whose issuance remains inherited from Paxos.

upgradeability.controlRef: StableEarn Prime PYUSD immutable VaultV2 share issuance

controls.label: StableEarn Prime PYUSD immutable VaultV2 share issuance
controls.evidence: Sourcify runtimeMatch verified VaultV2 (21808 bytes) with zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. Shares mint only after PYUSD transfer and on configured fee accrual (currently performanceFee = 0, managementFee = 0). At block 48443292, totalSupply = 78423725872575146561234953, totalAssets = 78572448141989, idle PYUSD = 15134224238568, sole adapter realAssets = 63438223903421, and all four gates are zero with receiveShares, sendShares, receiveAssets, and adapterRegistry setters permanently abdicated. No Paxos PYUSD minting authority is conveyed.

controls.label: StableEarn Prime PYUSD owner parameter authority
controls.evidence: At Stable block 48443381, owner() returns 0x42d510edeb9257f8d920d5b9f5109d95cb22419d with empty code (EOA). Owner can appoint curator, sentinels, and transfer ownership; it cannot create unbacked shares or mint native PYUSD. Off-chain key custody and human signer independence are undisclosed.

controls.label: StableEarn Prime PYUSD curator parameter authority
controls.evidence: At Stable block 48443381, curator() returns 0xa13094eced689b7419baba12851374424c1486f1 with empty code (EOA). Curator controls timelocked adapter and allocation-cap changes (604800s delay), fee parameters and forceDeallocatePenalty (259200s delay), and immediate setIsAllocator, setSendAssetsGate, and setSkimRecipient (0s delay); allocation caps are strategy limits rather than a native PYUSD mint ceiling. Off-chain key custody and signer independence remain undisclosed.

As allocator it routes liquidity within approved caps and configures liquidityAdapter and maxRate; as sentinel it can deallocate, lower caps, and revoke pending timelocked changes. It cannot raise caps or mint unbacked shares. Off-chain key custody is undisclosed.

review.evidence: At Stable blocks 48443292 through 48443741 (2026-11-27T13:06:01Z to 13:11:13Z), Sourcify-verified VaultV2 (21808 bytes), MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 (11784 bytes), and BluePublicAllocator (7697 bytes) were independently read on-chain. EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots on VaultV2 are zero. Selector (timelock seconds, abdicated) census: addAdapter [604800, 0], removeAdapter [604800, 0], increaseAbsoluteCap [604800, 0], increaseRelativeCap [604800, 0], increaseTimelock [604800, 0], setPerformanceFee [259200, 0], setManagementFee [259200, 0], setPerformanceFeeRecipient [259200, 0], setManagementFeeRecipient [259200, 0], setForceDeallocatePenalty [259200, 0], setAdapterRegistry [0, 1], setReceiveAssetsGate [0, 1], setReceiveSharesGate [0, 1], setSendSharesGate [0, 1], setSendAssetsGate [0, 0], setIsAllocator [0, 0], setSkimRecipient [0, 0], decreaseTimelock [0, 0]. Owner (0x42d510edeb9257f8d920d5b9f5109d95cb22419d), curator (0xa13094eced689b7419baba12851374424c1486f1), allocator (0x20346461dbcf3373fd59cbc1ace0e6f9c263e64b), and allocator/sentinel (0x4cd8558edd19a79b432ef88b351d9aef0a2c0e04) are all codeless EOAs; the third allocator is Sourcify-verified BluePublicAllocator (0x5c884d4b1510ead302ec50a2ab4de9c0b9e407ce). All three active cap IDs (adapter, collateral, market) have absoluteCap = uint128 max and relativeCap = 100%; these are strategy allocation limits, not native PYUSD mint ceilings. Share issuance requires deposited PYUSD and cannot mint native PYUSD, which stays inherited from Paxos. Off-chain key custody and signer independence for the EOA controllers remain unestablished.
